2030 Goal: Scope 1 and 2 GHG Emissions
Description. Drive a 10% reduction in our absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions from 2020 to 2030. 
Baseline. The percent reduction will be measured from our 2019 full-year emissions. Our combined Scope 1 and Scope 2 
GHG emissions in 2019 were 2.88 million metric tonnes of CO2e. 
Progress in 2020. Through the end of 2020, we maintained Scope 1 and 2 emissions roughly flat to the 2019 baseline, 
even with significant manufacturing growth. 
Looking Ahead. In 2021, we will continue to take action on emissions reduction strategies focused on emissions abate-
ment, continued investments in renewable electricity, process and equipment optimization, and energy conservation.
